exposure: subarachnoid block for elective caesarean section
cohort: 240 parturients aged 15 to 40 years undergoing elective caesarean section at a tertiary care hospital in Lahore, Pakistan.
finding: High Apgar scores (1-minute >= 7: 97.1%; 5-minute >= 8: 98.7%) were observed in parturients receiving subarachnoid block for elective caesarean section.
followup_time: Length of post-op stay (<= 4 days: 74.2%; > 4 days: 25.8%)
